annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously specifies that a server must process ACK frames in unprotected packets until either the TLS handshake is reported as complete or it receives an ACK frame in a protected packet that acknowledges all of its handshake messages. No alternative reasonable interpretations or missing constraints are evident.
